*Workshop archive. This event was cancelled; the linked agenda records the planned program.*

The Shale Network workshop scheduled for May 14–15, 2020, in State College, Pennsylvania, was cancelled because of the COVID-19 pandemic.

The planned theme was **Shale Gas: Future and Developing Issues**. The program included presentations on health effects related to shale gas development and a proposed field trip to energy facilities. These were plans for the cancelled event, not completed workshop activities.
